findings.finding: Q3 revenue and EBIT were pre-released on 14 Oct as inside information (EBIT 72.0m vs 45.8m, revenue 175.0m vs 146.6m), the stock gapped +20.6% that day and has added ~6% since; the report's headline lines are therefore known.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 followed the same pattern: preliminary revenue on 2026-07-06 moved +17.6%, the full report on 2026-07-16 moved +1.95% (Yahoo daily closes).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the 14 Oct close of 102 (+20.6% on 498,614 shares, ~15x normal volume) is the market absorbing it. Filed so the zero is explicit.
findings.independence: Swedish wire copy carries the same numbers: https://efn.se/omvand-vinstvarning-micro-systemation-rusar ('Aktien rusar över 20 procent')

findings.finding: The SEK 25.7m European defense order announced 1 Sept was guided to be recognised in Q3; it is ~15% of the 175m pre-released revenue, so if fully booked the rest of the business grew only ~2% y/y, which the full report's breakdown will expose.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of a single order dominating a quarter found for this name; European stage lesson: a beat made of a one-off is sold (H&M).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the arithmetic is public (HurBra did it on 14 Oct), but the stock kept rising after the pre-release to 108.5, above both analysts' last values, which looks like the market reading the 41% margin as run-rate; if the order's share were priced the post-14-Oct drift would have been flat or down. The order may be multi-year licences, so the true one-off share is unknown -- hence small.
findings.independence: HurBra's analysis of the pre-release computes the same ~149m ex-order and 2.7m y/y: https://hurbra.se/msab-q3-2026/ (2026-10-14) -- same underlying documents, not independent evidence of the reaction.

findings.finding: The Q2 report warned that MSAB is replacing parts of its solutions with new suppliers, which may slow some upgrades this autumn -- a Q4 headwind the Q3 report's outlook commentary will have to address.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026: a Reuters brief reported the company said investments led to a bigger Q1 loss and could weigh on the rest of 2026 (https://www.stockopedia.com/share-prices/micro-systemation-ab-publ-STO:MSAB B/news/sweden-apos-s-micro-systemation-says-investments-leads-to-bigger-q1-loss-could-hit-rest-of-2026-019e6a20-2823-7caf-86e9-be6f2182abd3/, 403, snippet_only); the baseline's estimated history puts the April print near +7%, so a cautious line has not reliably sold this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Three months old and overshadowed by the Q3 beat; the 14 Oct release only reiterated long-term targets and warned of quarter-to-quarter variability, so nobody has quantified the autumn effect. If priced, the stock would not have drifted above both July targets after the pre-release.
findings.independence: CEO quote in the 14 Oct pre-release: 'regional market conditions and public sector investment cycles may impact performance in individual quarters' (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bafd87a96b40dc09d6750324a51ae476e&lang=en&src=listed)

findings.finding: Q3 is MSAB's weak cash quarter: Q3 2025 operating cash flow was SEK 3.1m on 45.8m EBIT, and the large order signed 1 Sept likely sits in receivables, so a weak Q3 cash line against a 72m EBIT is plausible and not in the pre-release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not measurable from the record found; European lesson: Luceco fell 5.5% on free cash flow on a day it raised guidance.
findings.original_quote: Q3 2025 operating cash flow was only 3.1 MSEK (article in Swedish; figure as summarised via WebFetch, Swedish string not extracted -- marked inference)
findings.why_not_priced: The pre-release gave no cash or working-capital data, so the line is genuinely new; but the seasonality is visible in last year's report, so a weak number is partly expected -- inference, sized small.
findings.independence: H1 2026 operating cash flow 24.4m against 5.2m EBIT shows cash lagging and catching up between quarters: https://www.inderes.se/releases/msab-interim-report-q2-2026

findings.finding: Both covering analysts' last published values sit at or below spot (Danske Bank target SEK 105 from 85, 17 July; DNB Carnegie fair value 78-96, 7 July) and no post-14-Oct revision was found, so estimate and target revisions after the full report are pending.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the Q2 pre-release DNB Carnegie raised its fair value the next day (07-07) and Danske the day after the report (07-17); the stock was flat-to-down over 07-07..07-17.
findings.original_quote: DNB Carnegie höjer motiverat värde för Micro Systemation efter starka preliminära siffror för Q2 (DNB Carnegie raises fair value for Micro Systemation after strong preliminary Q2 figures)
findings.why_not_priced: With two analysts and $217k/day turnover the price has already run through both targets, so revisions are likely anticipated; sized small. If priced fully the stock would sit at a new consensus target, which nobody has published.
